create_datareader: create a DataReader instance to load TFRecord datasets for grid cell network training
read_batch_data: read a batch of position, heading, velocity, and target tensors from the DataReader queue
get_coord_range: get the coordinate range tuple for the loaded dataset
build_dataset_files: build a list of TFRecord file paths for a given dataset and root directory
review_datareader_init: review the DataReader __init__ method and its queue configuration parameters
